programs.title: Who Decides When a Robot Joins the Crew?
outcomes: Explain how an agent-managed DAO separates agent operations from human-reserved votes like governance.final_vote and treasury.transfer
Draft a workplace clause requiring human sign-off on physical-AI deployment decisions affecting jobs
Read a JPL-style deployment example and identify who is accountable at each stage

sessions.activity: Study the DAO charter and reserved-for-humans list; map which robotics deployment decisions at a worksite must stay with people vs. can be agent-prepared.
Review evidence summaries on robotics and automation; physical-AI deployment governance; practice spotting claims that lack sourcing.
Small groups draft a deployment-safeguards proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter format; peers debate, then hold a mock human-only final vote.
Define measurable outcomes for the proposal and build a simple progress dashboard the Progress Tracker would maintain.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized job-task inventories and proposed safeguard clauses, tagged by industry only, to a shared model of physical-AI deployment risks.
programs.consent: Adult participants give written consent at enrollment; can withdraw anytime; no employer-identifying data collected; data aggregated before sharing.

programs.title: Rovers Above the Arroyo: Governing Real Robots
outcomes: Describe how JPL rovers above the Arroyo Seco chaparral are physical AI operating far from human help
Compare agent tasks vs. human-only decisions in a robotics DAO
Write and vote on a classroom deployment rule for a simple robot

sessions.activity: Explore the JPL place card: rovers as physical AI in the wild; teams list what a rover must decide alone vs. what mission control decides.
Read the DAO's five-zone charter; sort example decisions into 'agents may do' and 'humans only' buckets.
Draft a class proposal for a classroom robot's rules using the proposal template; hold a real vote where only students (not the teacher-agent) decide.
Track one week of robot-rule outcomes on a chart and discuss what to change next cycle.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized class proposals and vote outcomes, with no student names, ages, or school identifiers, added to a shared model of youth governance reasoning.
programs.consent: Guardian/parent written consent required before participation; guardians can opt out of data sharing while still joining activities; no personal data stored.

programs.title: Evidence to Action: Monitoring Physical-AI Deployment
outcomes: Use the Research Synthesis Lab workflow to summarize robotics and automation governance evidence with cited sources
Convert evidence summaries into decision-ready proposals without enacting them
Track measurable outcomes across program cycles

sessions.activity: Practice the Evidence Monitor workflow: scan developments, summarize findings, and flag unsupported claims in sample briefs.
Simulate Collaborator Scout and Task Router roles to build a working-group plan for a robotics policy campaign.
Turn a synthesis into a drafted proposal with measurable outcomes; peer review against the charter before a mock human vote.
Design indicators and reporting cadence the Progress Tracker would maintain for the campaign.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized campaign case studies and indicator frameworks, stripped of partner and beneficiary identities, contributed to shared governance models.
programs.consent: Staff sign a data-use agreement; partner and beneficiary data excluded by default; withdrawal permitted at any stage.

programs.title: Governance as a Public Good: Running a Mission DAO
outcomes: Explain the 'agents operate; people govern' principle and its six human-reserved actions
Assess whether a mission-focused DAO structure fits a nonprofit's charter and accountability needs
Design measurable outcomes and a steward review cycle

sessions.activity: Board-level walkthrough of the charter, mission, and reserved-for-humans list; map each action to existing nonprofit governance roles.
Board members act as stewards: review agent-drafted proposals, debate, and cast the final vote agents cannot take.
Plan how Task Router and working groups would carry approved decisions between board cycles.
Set three measurable charter outcomes and a reporting rhythm; draft the accountability dashboard layout.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized governance-design choices and outcome templates, with no donor, client, or organizational identifiers, added to shared DAO-design models.
programs.consent: Leadership authorizes participation via signed agreement; anonymization applied before any sharing; opt-out honored without affecting participation.
